results.description:
Get the best out of your rides by transforming your smartphone into a motorcycle tool using the BMW Motorrad Connected app.

Use our app to plan your dream routes or import routes as a GPX file.

Thanks to the networking with your motorcycle, you can record all the relevant information about your ride if you want.

If your BMW motorcycle is equipped with a TFT display and Connectivity, simply connect to your motorcycle with Bluetooth to do this.

If your BMW motorcycle does not have a TFT display but does have a Multi-Controller and navigation preparation, then get the ConnectedRide Cradle and turn your smartphone into a motorcycle display.

No matter whether you choose the option of “fast” (direct route) or “curvy” (route with a lot of turns), you can always keep your route reliably in view thanks to voice announcements to your communication system and navigation instructions that are easy to see in the display. By using the intuitive Multi-Controller, you can control everything safely without having to take your hands off the handlebars.

Want to keep your friends up to date? Then easily share your riding data and photos on social media.

We are continuously refining our app for you. Stay tuned to discover the latest functions. 

Here is an overview of all the features that the BMW Motorrad Connected app currently offers you:

#Route Planning.
•	Route planning and storage with waypoints
•	Motorcycle-specific navigation with "winding route" route criterion
•	Weather information for current location
•	Route import and export (GPX files)
•	Free map download for offline use

#Navigation.
•	Motorcycle navigation suitable for everyday use
•	Arrow navigation in the 6.5” TFT display
•	Map navigation in the 10.25” TFT display or ConnectedRide Cradle
•	Voice announcements possible (if communication system present)
•	Turn-by-turn instructions, including lane recommendations
•	Current traffic data
•	Speed limit display
•	Point-of-Interest search

#Tour Recording.
•	Recording distances traveled including vehicle data
•	Analysis of performance values such as banking angle, acceleration and engine speed
•	Route export (GPX files)
•	Sharing recorded journeys and photos on social media

#Vehicle Data.
•	Current mileage
•	Tank capacity and remaining range
•	Tire pressure (with TPM optional equipment)
•	Online service appointment scheduling

Application Notices.
•	The app is part of BMW Motorrad Connectivity and can only be used in combination with vehicles with a TFT display or ConnectedRide Cradle. The connection between smartphone, vehicle/cradle and—if present—communication system is established wirelessly via Bluetooth. It can be operated with the Multi-Controller on the handlebars. To output music, telephony and navigation information, the use of the BMW Motorrad communication system is recommended.
•	A mobile Internet connection is necessary to receive traffic data. This can result in costs in accordance with the contract between the customer and provider (such as roaming charges).
•	Be aware that the functionality of your smartphone and the connection to the vehicle also depend on national requirements and conditions, and therefore cannot be guaranteed by BMW Motorrad at all times.
•	The BMW Motorrad Connected app is displayed in the language configured in the smartphone. Please note that not all languages are supported.
•	Continuous use of GPS localization in the background may lead to a reduced battery life.

Make Life a Ride.

Moto Shed is a motorcycle maintenance tracker and service log built for riders who want to organize their motorcycle garage, track repairs, log fuel, and never miss critical maintenance. It also works great for tracking cars, trucks, and other vehicles in your garage.

Increase your resale value, stay ahead of maintenance, and generate a professional service history in seconds. Moto Shed is a clean, ad-free maintenance app designed for riders and vehicle owners who want complete control of their service records, parts, and ownership costs.

Track maintenance, fuel usage, upgrades, and reminders for every motorcycle and vehicle you own.

Motorcycle Maintenance and Service Logging
Record oil changes, tire replacements, valve adjustments, chain service, repairs, upgrades, and parts. Create a complete service history with mileage, parts, labor, and detailed notes so you always know exactly what has been done to your motorcycle, car, truck, or other vehicle.

Fuel and Mileage Tracking
Log fuel fill-ups and fuel costs while tracking long-term mileage and fuel economy trends. Understand how your riding and driving habits affect fuel usage and ownership costs.

Smart Maintenance Reminders
Never forget important service again. Set reminders for oil changes, tire replacement, valve checks, belts, chain maintenance, inspections, insurance, and registration. Alerts can be based on time, mileage, or both. You can also create fully custom maintenance items for any vehicle.

Custom Maintenance Tracking
Track anything you want, not just predefined service items. Create custom repairs, upgrades, inspections, modifications, or recurring maintenance tasks tailored to your motorcycle, car, truck, or project vehicle.

VIN Recall Monitoring
Enter your motorcycle VIN to receive automatic NHTSA recall alerts and safety notifications so you stay informed about manufacturer recalls that may affect your bike.

Cost and Ownership Tracking
Moto Shed automatically tracks parts, labor, fuel, and repairs so you can understand the true cost of owning your motorcycle and other vehicles over time.

Garage Organization
Store everything related to your vehicles in one place including photos, part numbers, owner manuals, service notes, and documentation.

Professional Sales Report
Generate a clean PDF service history report when selling your motorcycle or vehicle. A detailed maintenance record helps build buyer confidence and can increase resale value.

Full Data Control
Export your service history via CSV. Backup and restore your garage using JSON when switching devices so your data always stays under your control.

Flexible and Personalized
Customize service intervals, categories, maintenance items, reminders, and alerts to match your motorcycle, vehicle, and maintenance habits. Choose from multiple themes and organize your garage the way you prefer.

Built for Every Garage
Moto Shed works for sport bikes, cruisers, touring motorcycles, dirt bikes, scooters, electric motorcycles, cars, trucks, SUVs, and project vehicles.

Global Support
Moto Shed supports miles or kilometers, multiple currencies, and 10 languages including English, Spanish, Hindi, Chinese, Indonesian, Japanese, French, German, Vietnamese, and Portuguese.

Keep your maintenance history organized, track ownership costs, and make sure your bikes and vehicles always run their best with Moto Shed.
